zh.lead: 今天最大的消息：Anthropic 将 A 类普通股 IPO 定价为每股 83.00 美元，共发行 9.80 亿股，股票代码 ANT，预计今日在纳斯达克全球精选市场开始交易。

important.title: 重要消息
items: Anthropic 确认 A 类股 IPO 定价 83.00 美元，发行 9.80 亿股（公司出售 9.56351354 亿股，股东出售 2364.8646 万股，公司不获得股东售股所得）。按官方数字，发行规模约 813.4 亿美元。股票代码 ANT，预计今日在纳斯达克全球精选市场开始交易，11 月 20 日交割；承销商另有 30 天期权可增购最多 1.47 亿股。

Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位在 Carbon 与 Hydrogen 之间。官方称其在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 的 xhigh 档得分 61、排第 3，Vals Index 第 2（70.9%）。API 为每百万 tokens 输入 3 美元、缓存 0.15 美元、输出 15 美元，上下文 100 万。即日起在 Gemini API、Gemini for business、Antigravity 与 Gemini 应用（Pro/Ultra）滚动上线。
Cursor 于 11 月 18 日把官方评测更新为 CursorBench 4.1（修改指令跟随题并提高 agent 时限），与 4.0 不可直接对比，完整榜现为 53 个配置。官方得分由 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High（65.4% / $10.67）和 Neon High（63.7%）领跑；性价比头部是 Haiku 5.5 Low（27.8% / $0.08）。
OpenAI 发布研究加速报告：在估计需 2–4 小时的研究任务上，agent 自主成功率从 3 月的 23% 升至 10 月的 46%，但人类仍处核心。公司呼吁公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标。另称与 AMD 合作，模型在不到五个月内为旗舰 GPU IP 找出最高约 14% 的 PPA 改进，并用于自研推理芯片 Jalapeño。

sections.title: Gemini 4 Neon：速度与前沿能力之间
sections.body: 官方把 Neon 放在「Carbon 攻坚长程难题、Hydrogen 做日常快速执行」之间，强调更快完成任务、单位成本更低，并可在 Antigravity 里作为 Orchestrator 调度 Hydrogen 子代理。同日 Project Genie 上线 Genie 4，加入原生音频、实时编辑和用于生成可交互世界的新 agent，先向符合条件的 Ultra 用户推出。

sections.title: OpenAI：研究透明与芯片设计
sections.body: 报告还写到，按 API 标价，10 月研究者日用量中位数约 2400 美元；安全与对齐的记录工作周从 1 月到 9 月增加 77%。另有一文说明其如何从早期研究到公开发布管理安全。芯片细节以官方介绍页为准。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Grok Bot changelog 已到 v1.2.3（11 月 18 日，含 1.2.1/1.2.2），重点是工具权限分级和例程重连卡片，cask 同为 1.2.3。codex 稳定版升到 0.170.0，TUI 加入实时语音的 WebRTC 协商。DeepSeek 自 11 月 18 日 12:00（北京时间）起，模型调用里的服务端搜索与抓取不再单独计费；Harness 实验标签到 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5。OpenClaw 稳定版仍为 v2026.11.5，另发布 LTS 向的 v2026.10.33。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng、Claude 官方账号与 Meta 近 36 小时未见高信号原创帖。Cursor 产品 changelog 自 11 月 6 日仍无新条目。水木单帖正文需验证码，摘要按标题与讨论热度撰写。

en.lead: Today’s biggest news: Anthropic priced its Class A IPO at $83.00 a share, offering 980 million shares. The stock, ticker ANT, is expected to begin trading today on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

important.title: Headlines
items: Anthropic priced its Class A IPO at $83.00, offering 980 million shares (956,351,354 by the company and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders; the company receives no proceeds from the latter). At the official count and price, the offering is about $81.34 billion. Ticker ANT is expected to start trading today on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, closing on November 20, with a 30-day underwriter option for up to 147 million more shares.

Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen. Google says it scores 61 and ranks 3rd on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh, and ranks 2nd on the Vals Index (70.9%). API pricing is $3 / $0.15 cached / $15 per million tokens, with a 1M context window. It begins rolling out today in the Gemini API, Gemini for business, Antigravity, and the Gemini app for Pro and Ultra.

On November 18 Cursor moved its official eval to CursorBench 4.1 (modified instruction-following problems and a higher agent time limit). Scores are not comparable with 4.0, and the table now has 53 configs. Official scores are led by Gemini 4 Neon Extra High (65.4% / $10.67) and Neon High (63.7%). The value leader is Haiku 5.5 Low (27.8% / $0.08).

OpenAI’s research-acceleration report says autonomous agent success on two-to-four-hour research tasks rose from 23% in March to 46% in October, while humans remain central. It argues labs should publicly report RSI indicators. A separate AMD collaboration post says its models identified up to 14% PPA improvement on flagship GPU IP in less than five months, and were also used on Jalapeño, OpenAI’s first custom inference chip.

sections.title: Gemini 4 Neon: between speed and frontier capability
sections.body: Google places Neon between Carbon (hard, long-horizon work) and Hydrogen (fast everyday execution), stressing faster completion and a lower cost per task, including use as an Orchestrator directing Hydrogen subagents in Antigravity. The same day, Genie 4 arrived in Project Genie with native audio, real-time editing, and a new agent for interactive worlds, starting with eligible Ultra subscribers.

sections.title: OpenAI: research transparency and chip design
sections.body: The report also notes that, at API list prices, median daily researcher usage reached about $2,400 in October, and documented Safety and Alignment effort rose 77% from January to September. A separate note covers safety across the model lifecycle. Chip-design details follow the official post.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: The Grok Bot changelog Latest is v1.2.3 (November 18, including 1.2.1 and 1.2.2), focused on per-tool permissions and routine reconnect cards; the Homebrew cask matches at 1.2.3. Codex stable moved to 0.170.0, adding WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice in the TUI. From 12:00 on November 18, Beijing time, DeepSeek no longer bills separately for server-side search and fetch inside a model call. Harness moved to dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5. OpenClaw’s current stable remains v2026.11.5, with a new LTS-style v2026.10.33.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: No high-signal original posts were found from Karpathy, Andrew Ng, the official Claude account, or Meta in the past roughly 36 hours. Cursor’s product changelog still has no new entry after November 6. NewSMTH post bodies require a captcha, so summaries are based on titles and discussion volume.

alphaxivTop3.title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yifan Wang, Weiguang Zhao, Ni Yang, Haoyu Guo, Junting Dong, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen et al.

summary.zh: 提出统一的 4D 场景感知基础模型 π^4。它可从单张图、无序图片或视频等未标定 RGB 输入中恢复几何、相机位姿与度量尺度，并给出点轨迹与运动物体掩码；全文系统约 5 亿参数。今日居 alphaXiv 热门第 1，替换了昨日的 ScaleVLA。
summary.en: π^4 is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From uncalibrated RGB inputs—a single image, an unordered set, or a video—it recovers geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, plus point tracks and moving-object masks. The full system has about 0.5B parameters. It is alphaXiv’s #1 today, replacing yesterday’s ScaleVLA.

caption.zh: π^4 论文缩略图（alphaXiv；已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Thumbnail for the π^4 paper (alphaXiv; mirrored in-repo)

alphaxivTop3.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ruixi Yu, Dairu Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, Zekai Li, Zhuo Cao et al.

summary.zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型扩到 5520 亿参数，把 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 骨干接到可训练的动作 DiT，并在 20 亿到 5520 亿规模下做对照。作者讨论少样本与泛化，文中也提到前沿 VLM（如 GPT-6 Astra）对机器人控制的启发。今日为热门第 2，较昨日的第 1 位后移。
summary.en: ScaleVLA scales vision-language-action models to 552 billion parameters, connecting a DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT and comparing VLMs from 2B to 552B. The authors discuss sample efficiency and generalization, and mention frontier VLMs such as GPT-6 Astra. It is #2 today, down from #1 yesterday.

caption.zh: ScaleVLA 论文缩略图（alphaXiv；已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Thumbnail for the ScaleVLA paper (alphaXiv; mirrored in-repo)

alphaxivTop3.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yu Yao, Jiayi Dong, Yilun Du

summary.zh: 把多智能体推理看成隐式信念动力学寻求均衡的过程，提出 Stream of Belief（SoB）：智能体保持连续的潜在信念，并通过通信与反思迭代更新，而不是互写长文本。今日仍居 alphaXiv 热门第 3。
summary.en: The paper treats multi-agent reasoning as seeking equilibrium in implicit belief dynamics and introduces Stream of Belief (SoB), in which agents keep continuous latent beliefs and refine them through communication and reflection instead of long written exchanges. It remains alphaXiv’s #3 today.

summary.zh: 当前稳定版仍为 v2026.11.5（2026-11-17T10:47:56Z）。今日另外发布了网关向的 extended-stable（相当于目前的 LTS）v2026.10.33（2026-11-18T04:15:53Z）：以 10 月底代码为底，叠了关键安全、可靠性与性能修复以及新模型支持，并不取代 11.5 作为最新稳定版。
summary.en: Current stable remains v2026.11.5 (2026-11-17T10:47:56Z). summary.zh: 实验标签由昨日的 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.4 推进到 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5（2026-11-18T12:51:39Z）。说明为体验优化：DeepSeek 模型使用 DeepSeek 服务端搜索，搜索不按次收费；其他模型默认使用 DeepSeek Search API。仍不是稳定版。这与官方定价页一致：自 11 月 18 日 12:00（北京时间）起，模型调用里触发的服务端搜索与抓取不再单独计费，只收 tokens；直接调用 Search/Fetch API 仍按次计费。
summary.en: The experimental tag moved from yesterday’s dsh-v0.2.2-rc.4 to dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5 (2026-11-18T12:51:39Z). The notes are a product improvement: DeepSeek models use DeepSeek server-side search with no per-search charge; other models default to the DeepSeek Search API. It is still not a stable release. This matches the official pricing page: from 12:00 on November 18, 2026 (Beijing time), server-side search and fetch triggered during a model call are no longer billed separately—only tokens are; direct Search/Fetch API calls remain per-request.

summary.zh: 稳定版由昨日的 0.169.1 升到 rust-v0.170.0 / 0.170.0（2026-11-18T03:40:48Z，约北京时间昨天 11:40）。发行说明中的新功能包括：TUI 里为实时语音通话加入 WebRTC 协商；为 OpenTelemetry HTTP 导出器自动刷新认证头；以及跨环境使用同名 MCP 服务器的实验支持。另有修复：过大的 WebSocket 请求会回退到 HTTP。实验线已到 rust-v0.172.0-alpha.1，这些预发布标签的说明仍只标版本号。
summary.en: Stable moved from yesterday’s 0.169.1 to rust-v0.170.0 / 0.170.0 (2026-11-18T03:40:48Z, about 11:40 Asia/Shanghai yesterday). The notes add WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI, automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters, and experimental support for identically named MCP servers across environments. A fix lets oversized WebSocket requests fall back to HTTP. The experimental line has reached rust-v0.172.0-alpha.1; those prerelease notes still name the version only.

summary.zh: 产品 changelog 自 11 月 6 日以来仍无新条目，置顶还是 Voice Chat with Agents（由 Grok Voice 驱动）。但官方评测页已切换到 CursorBench 4.1（changelog 日期 2026-11-18）：修改了指令跟随题并提高了 agent 时限，与 4.0 不可直接对比，详见「模型」板块。
summary.en: The product changelog still has no new entry since November 6, and still leads with Voice Chat with Agents (powered by Grok Voice). The official eval page has moved to CursorBench 4.1 (changelog date 2026-11-18), with modified instruction-following problems and a higher agent time limit; scores are not comparable with 4.0. See the Models section.

summary.zh: 官方 changelog Latest 已更新为 v1.2.3（标注日期 2026-11-18），标题为「Tool permissions and routine reconnect cards」，并写明同时包含 1.2.1 与 1.2.2。新内容包括：可在连接器页面把每个工具设为始终允许、自动审核、需要批准或禁用；点击 MCP App 消息按钮会把文本放入输入框待发送；注册需年满 18 岁；团队管理员可限制内置 GitHub 连接器提供的工具。改进集中在例程掉线后的重连卡片（也会发到通知和 Slack / Teams）、例程在聊天中读取先前对话，以及优先使用已有连接器而不是直接开浏览器。Homebrew cask 同样报 1.2.3，与 changelog 对齐。
summary.en: The official changelog Latest is now v1.2.3 (dated 2026-11-18), titled “Tool permissions and routine reconnect cards,” and the notes say it also includes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2. New items include setting each connector tool to Always allow, Auto-review, Needs approval, or Blocked; clicking a message button in an MCP App puts its text in the chat box ready to send; sign-up requires being 18 or older; and team admins can limit which tools the built-in GitHub connector offers. Improvements focus on reconnect cards when a routine loses a sign-in (also delivered as a notification and as a Slack or Teams DM), letting routines read earlier conversation in the chat they run in, and preferring an existing connector over opening the browser. The Homebrew cask also reports 1.2.3, matching the changelog.

changeSummary.zh: CursorBench 由昨日的 4.0（91 个配置）升级为 4.1（53 个配置）。官方 changelog 日期为 2026-11-18，说明修改了指令跟随题并提高了 agent 时限，因此今日分数不可与 4.0 直接对比。新榜引入 Gemini 4 Neon 系列，并去掉了昨日 4.0 中的部分配置（如 GPT-5.6 Luna）。官方得分现由 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High（65.4%）和 Neon High（63.7%）领跑。
changeSummary.en: CursorBench moved from yesterday’s 4.0 (91 configs) to 4.1 (53 configs). The official changelog is dated 2026-11-18 and cites modified instruction-following problems and a higher agent time limit, so today’s scores are not comparable with 4.0. The new table introduces the Gemini 4 Neon family and drops some 4.0 configs (such as GPT-5.6 Luna). Official scores are now led by Gemini 4 Neon Extra High (65.4%) and Neon High (63.7%).

summary.zh: 这是 CursorBench 4.1 的首日对照，分数不可与昨日 4.0 直接比较。按得分÷单任务成本，性价比最高的是 Haiku 5.5 Low（27.8% / $0.08，约 347.5 分/$），随后是 Haiku 5.5 Medium（34.2% / $0.17）和 Haiku 5.5 High（37.5% / $0.31）。在分数更高的区间，Gemini 4 Neon Medium（官方第 9，57.7% / $3.07，约 18.79 分/$）和 Neon High（官方第 2，63.7% / $6.54，约 9.74 分/$）更均衡。官方得分由 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High（65.4% / $10.67）和 Neon High 领跑，随后是 Gemini 4 Carbon High（61.5%）与 Hydrogen Extra High（61.4%）；Fable 5.2 Max 以 61.3% / $48.11 位列官方第 5。
summary.en: This is the first day of CursorBench 4.1; scores are not comparable with yesterday’s 4.0. Ranked by score ÷ cost per task, the highest-value config is Haiku 5.5 Low (27.8% / $0.08, about 347.5 pts/$), ahead of Haiku 5.5 Medium (34.2% / $0.17) and Haiku 5.5 High (37.5% / $0.31). In a higher-score range, Gemini 4 Neon Medium (official #9, 57.7% / $3.07, about 18.79 pts/$) and Neon High (official #2, 63.7% / $6.54, about 9.74 pts/$) are more balanced. Official scores are led by Gemini 4 Neon Extra High (65.4% / $10.67) and Neon High, followed by Gemini 4 Carbon High (61.5%) and Hydrogen Extra High (61.4%); Fable 5.2 Max is official #5 at 61.3% / $48.11.

text.zh: 今日重心（周四去敏）：工作上继续拆解生产架构细节并做上线规划重构，同时讨论海外版本快速迭代如何保证质量，并整理小爱 Plus 当前安全基线，供月底到岗的安全架构工作作为起点；也计划刷新 Session、Context、Turn、Step 等一般定义。学习侧继续技术文章阅读，推进安全架构课中的信任边界，以及 harness 工程与 RSI/DDD、pstack 方向的研究；实体硬件上的语音问答按计划推进。通识课仍在进行中。
text.en: Thursday focus (sanitized): on the work side, continue breaking down production-architecture details and the launch-planning refactor, discuss how to keep quality in rapid overseas iteration, and put together the current Xiaoai Plus security baseline as a starting point for security-architecture work arriving at month-end; also refresh general definitions of Session, Context, Turn, and Step. On the learning side, keep up with technical reading, continue the security-architecture lesson on trust boundaries, plus harness engineering and RSI/DDD, and pstack study; hardware voice-QA work continues as planned. The general-education course is still in progress.
